info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employer Payroll Management API
info.description: The Employer Payroll Management API allows businesses to efficiently update payroll service details for specific employers. By targeting a unique employer ID, users can modify existing payroll configurations, ensuring compliance and accuracy in disbursements. This API is ideal for HR departments and payroll administrators seeking to manage employee compensation effectively. With seamless integration options, it supports businesses in maintaining up-to-date payroll practices and enhancing financial accuracy.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the payroll services associated with a specific employer identified by their unique resource ID. Ensure all required fields are correctly filled out to successfully make the update.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update payroll services for a specific employer identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the data provided conforms to the specified schema to process the request successfully.
